description: Create a maintenance/service notification in SAP, e.g. from a field-service report: short text, long text (the report), technical object (equipment or functional location), priority. WRITES — permission gate + write log; dry run unless the connection is live.

dry_run.description: true = build and log the request but send nothing. Writes are ALWAYS dry runs while the tenant's SAP connection has write_mode "dry_run" (the default).

equipment.description: SAP equipment number of the technical object

functional_location.description: SAP functional location of the technical object

long_text.description: Long text of the notification, e.g. the field-service report

reported_by.description: name of the reporting person, added to the long text

name: create_sap_maintenance_notification
